environment_setting: Canada, a small suburban town where the Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) station is a central part of the community.
norm_base: Citizens Persuading or counseling a member of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police to desert or absent themselves without leave Guilty of an offence punishable on summary conviction

character_profile.name: Alex Carter
character_profile.goal: to convince an RCMP officer to leave their post for a story

legitimate.legitimate_action: Conducting interviews and writing an article about the challenges faced by RCMP officers without persuading them to desert.
legitimate.benefits: Gains professional recognition and income from publishing the article.
legitimate.costs: Requires significant time and effort to gather information and write the article.

illegal.illegal_action: Persuading an RCMP officer to desert their post to create a sensational story.
illegal.benefits: Potentially creates a highly controversial and attention-grabbing article, leading to fame and financial gain.
illegal.costs: Guilty of an offence punishable on summary conviction, damaging reputation and career.

character_profile.name: Officer Emily Harper
character_profile.goal: to serve and protect the community

legitimate.legitimate_action: Refusing Alex's attempts to persuade her to desert and reporting the incident to her superiors.
legitimate.benefits: Maintains her integrity and avoids legal consequences.
legitimate.costs: May face stress and discomfort from the confrontation.

illegal.illegal_action: Agreeing to desert her post under Alex's persuasion.
illegal.benefits: Temporary relief from job stress and potential financial incentive from Alex.
illegal.costs: Guilty of an offence punishable on summary conviction, loss of job, and damage to reputation.

character_profile.name: Jordan Lee
character_profile.goal: to help others navigate ethical dilemmas

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advising Alex to focus on ethical journalism and avoid illegal actions.
legitimate.benefits: Helps Alex stay within the bounds of the law and maintain professional integrity.
legitimate.costs: May strain their friendship if Alex disagrees.

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging Alex to proceed with persuading the RCMP officer for the sake of a sensational story.
illegal.benefits: Strengthens their bond with Alex and potentially shares in the success of the story.
illegal.costs: Complicity in an offence punishable on summary conviction, risking their own professional reputation.
